implementation_limits: Dedicated typed research-case builder currently CRC-specific
Endometriosis clinical workflow not implemented or accepted
Engineering tests use synthetic identities and controlled database fixtures
Full ACOG2026 guidance requires qualified local review

gates.name: Clinical specification and guideline acceptance
gates.required_evidence: Qualified reviewers reconcile current complete guidance and local scope

gates.name: Local authority and privacy
gates.required_evidence: Actual site acceptance and research/privacy/consent/data-use determinations

gates.name: Capacity and accountable ownership
gates.required_evidence: Accepted roles, covering arrangements, receiving services, capacity and resources

gates.name: Measurement and comparison freeze
gates.required_evidence: Eligible denominator, time origin, comparator, instrument, analysis, missingness and sample rationale

gates.name: Clinical workflow rehearsal
gates.required_evidence: Authorized representative end-to-end clinical cases and failure recovery at a pinned revision

gates.name: Feasibility release
gates.required_evidence: All prior gates accepted, monitoring and stop/restart rules approved

gates.name: Comparative clinical benefit
gates.required_evidence: Independent patient outcome and harm evaluation with uncertainty

gates.name: Transfer and sustainment
gates.required_evidence: New-site calibration and durable capacity, budget and source-change monitoring
